prompt: In intervals.py implement three functions over half-open intervals [start, end) given as (start, end) tuples of numbers. merge(intervals) returns a new sorted list of disjoint intervals covering exactly the same points: overlapping AND touching intervals (one ends where the next starts) are joined into one, and empty intervals (start == end) are dropped. Every function raises ValueError when any input interval (in either argument of subtract) has start > end, even one that would be dropped or absorbed. subtract(a, b) returns the merged form of the points that are in the union of a and not in the union of b. total_length(intervals) returns the length of the union of the intervals (an int when all bounds are ints). None of the functions may modify their arguments, and the input lists may be unsorted. Keep the three function names and signatures.
